task.objective: Twenty-four settlements govern water, crossings and finite infrastructure while individually controllable residents cultivate and exchange provisions.
task.natural_termination: This is a persistent finite-window strategy game with no natural success termination: terminated remains false and H=1024 truncates. Fields and projects do not reset when harvested or completed.
task.interaction: Opening or redirecting an upstream canal injects visible parcels that retain destination through a three-slot transit queue; later arrivals change another settlement's irrigation and flood conditions. Guards alter entry rights, while couriers and material/tool transfers alter available construction and provisions.
task.observation_access: Actors and non-agent entities use L1 radius 6; only four nearest actor slots plus self are exposed. A settlement's own provisions and all permissions granted to that settlement are shared knowledge within its crew. Remote water is absent unless a resident reads a local gauge and broadcasts its remembered value near another actor; messages may be stale. Static territory ownership is public.
